title: Tracy Business WordPress theme 1.1.9: the released theme carries the identity fallback (site title, initials, uploaded logo when tracy_site_identity is absent) and the design system contract admits it
steps: S3: Read Version: in packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/wp-tracy-business/style.css and maxVersion in packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/wordpress-tracy-business.json.
expect: S1: every test passes: with no identity option the site title renders as the name and its initials as the mark, an empty title renders no mark; the generated wp-tracy-business tree matches overlays/wp-tracy-business/theme.config.json, version 1.1.9 or newer.
S2: every test passes: the wp-tracy-business theme's Version is not past the contract's maxVersion.
S3: both numbers are 1.1.9 or newer and equal to each other.
evidence: Measured 13/10/2026: tracy-business/wp7 1.3.6 on cowork.tracy.site drew an empty green square for its logo; the fix of PR #1301 sat on develop under the already released number 1.1.8, so no site could take it
fence: The theme's look under a worn design system is unchanged: the stylesheet keeps its 21 var(--ds-*) reads and tracy_apply_inspiration; sites with an identity option render as before
